note: Registry engines llgenie deliberately ships no skill/image for (issue #229). registry-sync carries every engine upstream lists, and rank_engines drops an engine with no image, so an engine with no skill must be a DECISION here - dated and reasoned - or it is not a decision at all. An engine in data/models.json with no skills/engines/<id>/SKILL.md and no entry here is NEW AND UNRESOLVED: `make check-engine-skill-gap` fails naming it, and the weekly registry-sync opens one tracking issue for it. Entries for an engine that later ships a skill, or that upstream stops listing, are stale: delete them (the gate fails until you do). Each reason below was read from the upstream repository's own README/releases, not inferred from the registry's one-line auto-registration note.

mlx-serve.reason: Upstream ships native binaries only (a brew cask plus linux CUDA tarballs), no container image, and it is an all-in-one app overlapping the MLX engine llgenie already serves natively.

oMLX.reason: Apple-Silicon server delivered as a macOS menu-bar app: Metal cannot run in a container, so it would need a native Metal skill, and llgenie already ships the `mlx` engine for that platform.

omlx-exl3.reason: Not a server at all: a patch set that adds ExLlamaV3's EXL3 format to oMLX (pinned to one commit, single author) and rides oMLX's own server on Apple Silicon.

ExLlamaV3.reason: Upstream is a quantization/inference library whose OpenAI API comes from a separate server (TabbyAPI), so there is no first-party server to image; llgenie ships the ExLlamaV3 ROCm-fork engine instead.

MegaCapybara.reason: Closed-source binaries (upstream says the source comes later) behind an interactive launcher, scoped to one model on one card (Qwen3.8-27B on an RTX 5090): there is no source, release tree or image to build from.

llama.cpp (LlamAmpere fork).reason: A llama.cpp fork tuned for Ampere cards only: llgenie ships stock llama.cpp plus the Prism and LaurentZuijdwijk forks, and a third fork is a permanent maintenance burden for a per-card gain.

glm-flash-lite.reason: A single-model (GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3) offload engine for one 24 GB card, built on SGLang + ExLlamaV3 - both of which llgenie already ships; a skill for it would duplicate two engines for one model.

Project Maya.reason: A single-model (GLM-5.3-Flash) engine + dashboard built on Strata, installed by a native setup script with no container image; llgenie already ships the Strata engine for that family.
